articleTitle: Investigation of Tensile Strength Performance of 3D Printed PLA, ABS and PET-G Materials for Various Industrial Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Objective of this paper is to investigate and compare the tensile strength of three commonly used 3D printing materials i.e. Poly Lactic Acid (PLA), Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS), and Polyethylene Terephthalate Glycol (PET-G) for various industrial applications. Tensile strength is a critical mechanical parameter, especially in applications subject to stretching forces. Through experimental testing, the tensile strength of each material was determined. The results revealed distinct mechanical behaviors among the materials, providing valuable insights for material selection and process optimization in additive manufacturing. This research contributes to advancing the understanding of the mechanical performance of 3D printed materials and informs practical applications in various industries.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in Multi-Store Retail Demand Forecasting: A Case Study of Tuenjai Panit Company
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This research focuses on time series data analysis by examining the mutual relationships in the data via autocorrelation and partial autocorrelation, and employs seasonal decomposition to segment the time series. Additionally, the best forecasting model for multi-store retail was identified using sales data from 2021 to 2023, employing the forecasting model types Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA), and SARIMA with eXogenous variables (SARIMAX). Four comparison criteria were used: Akaike Information Criterion (AIC), Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and Mean Absolute Error (MAE). These indicated that the SARIMA was the best model type tested in this research.

articleTitle: Examining the Smart Tourism Landscape: A Bibliometric Study and Analytical Synopsis of IoT Research
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This paper explores how IoT technologies are revolutionizing smart tourism with the goal of improving passenger experiences and operational efficiency. Key research trends in the field are identified by utilizing a bibliometric analysis and systematic literature assessment of 83 papers from SCOPUS till December 2023. The combination of technologies like Big data, wearables, AR, VR, cloud computing, ML, AI, and smart sensors is what makes IoT-driven smart tourism so unique. These developments provide unique features including cloud computing for data processing and storage, as well as improved data collection via integrated sensors. Examining several Internet of Things (IoT) applications related to smart tourism, like smart cities, recommender systems, electronic ticketing, and payment methods, highlights how important these applications are to improving security, and customized services. However, other problems—like security, privacy, complicated software, scalability, and compatibility—need strong answers. This study suggests future research directions spanning blockchain integration, edge computing, and improvement of visitor-smart tourism system interactions in addition to strengthening security and privacy protections. These programs seek to solve issues and seize possibilities in the face of an environment that is becoming more and more reliant on technology, all the while encouraging creative responses to the changing needs of the travel and tourist industry.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology the Leading Area Over the World and Navigating the Blockchain Landscape
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Blockchain technology, popularized by Bitcoin, is revolutionizing the manner in which digital transactions occur. It provides a decentralized, secure, and transparent system for the whole process. This paper will elaborate in detail the structure, mechanisms, and applications of Blockchain with a focus on Bitcoin. Blockchain is enabling the maintenance of a distributed ledger using cryptographic protocols and consensus algorithms such as Proof of Work, thus creating an immutable, verifiable record that does not require any form of third-party oversight. The transformative power of Blockchain in finance, healthcare, and supply chain management research. Blockchain offers trustless transactions, asset tracking, and improved security across industry domains. The advantages over traditional systems include transparency, security, and efficiency, with scalability, energy consumption, and regulatory issues being considered the main drawbacks. Further directions for the future emphasize the optimization of scalability, development of energy-efficient protocols, and expanded applications. Blockchain promises to be a powerful, trust-based digital economy that is going to change the paradigm of traditional systems and set a new standard for data integrity and trust.

articleTitle: Predicting Patient No-shows in Medical Appointments Using Demographic and Health Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Non-attendance at scheduled medical appointments, or "no-shows," significantly disrupts healthcare delivery and resource allocation. This study utilizes demographic and healthrelated data to predict and analyze patient no-shows, employing machine learning techniques to identify the most influential predictors. Using a dataset encompassing various patient characteristics—age, gender, scholarship status, and medical conditions such as hypertension and diabetes, the study applies different predictive models. The goal was to discern patterns and factors contributing to patient absenteeism. The research not only enhances understanding of factors influencing no-shows but also proposes actionable strategies to mitigate their occurrence, thereby optimizing healthcare resources and improving patient care management. The findings suggest that targeted interventions based on predictive analytics can effectively reduce no-show rates, providing a valuable tool for healthcare providers in improving operational efficiency and patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Critical Success Factors for Implementation of Smart Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Information and Communication Technology (ICT) has become an inevitable aspect of economic and social development. Education, being one of them, is also transformed through the ICT tools. With the emergence of smart cities, education is also advancing in the same direction and smart education has become the paradigm shift in teaching learning ecosystem. Since there will be a lot of efforts associated with bringing the technological and infrastructural strength to implement smart education in the smart city, it is important to research about associated factors. Thus, the current paper highlights the factors responsible for implementing smart education successfully. The model depicts the impact of three critical factors Teacher’s Perspective, Administrators Perspective and Student Perspective influence successful implementation of Smart Education. These three stakeholder’s perspectives are vital in designing the successful implementation of smart education specifically in the higher education institute

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Implementation in Finance and Accounting Function of Manufacturing Firms in USA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The rapid pace of change in the finance and accounting sectors is due to the tremendous improvements in utilizing Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Robotics. The paper offers a thematic analysis of the implementation of AI and robotics in the financial and accounting domains, identifying the trends that will define the industry's future. The analysis articles on the challenges and advantages of using these technologies in changing financial processes, the accuracy of accounting practices, regulation, and the profession's scope. The paper tries to interact with the focus of this research, which is how AI and robotics are used to enhance operation procedures without failing to point out the problems of implementation, ethics, and functionality.

articleTitle: Geographical Indications for Fruits Quality and their Potential for Rural Development using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The significance of Geographical Indications (GI) tags in agriculture has been growing. Recently, there has been a notable focus on safeguarding the genuineness and standards of agricultural goods. This research suggests a new method that utilizes cutting-edge machine learning techniques to distinguish genuine fruits using their images and where they are grown. The system is designed in a way that it can identify the unique features of fruits grown in various areas to verify if a fruit is truly from its original source. To accomplish this, we will develop a strong deep learning model using an extensive dataset of fruit photos and their associated Geographical Indication (GI) tags. The model will be trained to recognize the distinct characteristics of fruits from certain areas and use this information to determine if new fruit images are genuine. We will also investigate incorporating extra data sources like weather and soil conditions to improve the accuracy of the prediction further. The mobile application will host the system, enabling both farmers and consumers to quickly recognize genuine fruits in real-time.

articleTitle: Combating Cyber Attacks by Malware Classification Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The detection and classification of malware pose significant challenges in cybersecurity due to the ever-evolving nature of malicious threats. In this study, we propose a novel approach for classifying malware using deep neural networks (DNNs). Our dataset comprises of 25 distinct classes of malware samples. After developing and testing 4 DNNs, including ResNet50, InceptionResNetV2, VGG16, DenseNet169, a robust and efficient model capable of accurately identifying and categorizing malware instances is built using DenseNet169. The process involves feature extraction from byteplot images.Our proposed malware detection model uses DenseNet169 as it has shown very high accuracy (95%), precision, recall and F1-score for the dataset.This research contributes to advancing the state-of-the-art in malware classification, providing insights into the efficacy of deep neural networks for combating sophisticated cyber threats in modern computing environments.

articleTitle: A Comparative Ranking of Developed vs. Emerging Stock Market Indices based on Resilience to Economic Shocks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This research paper conducts a comparative ranking of developed and emerging stock market indices based on their resilience to economic shocks, specifically the 2008 financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic. Developed market indices include the S&P 500 (USA), FTSE100 (UK), DAX(Germany), CAC 40(France), and Nikkei 225(Japan), while emerging market indices include the BSE Sensex(India), Shanghai Composite(China), MOEX (Russia), Bovespa(Brazil), and JSE Top40(South Africa). The key financial metrics examined are volatility, recovery time, and maximum drawdown. The Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is employed as the ranking tool to evaluate and compare these indices based on their performance during these crises. Findings reveal distinct differences in resilience between developed and emerging markets, with developed markets generally demonstrating quicker recovery times, though emerging markets often show lower volatility.

articleTitle: Analyzing Residents Behavioral Intentions to Recycle Electronic Waste: A PLS-SEM Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Adoption of e-waste recycling needs awareness and has cost implications. This study explores the factors influencing residents' intentions to recycle e-waste using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling. Data was collected from 210 respondents and a structural model was created with eleven hypotheses to investigate the direct and mediated relationship among the factors influencing the adoption of e- waste recycling behavior. The research concludes that environmental awareness is an important driver in knowing the laws and regulations, recycling cost and any inconvenience in recycling. Experience and social pressure directly influence the adoption behavior. The study also contributes that three unrelated constructs namely cost of recycling, laws and regulations, inconvenience of recycling mediates the relationship between awareness and behavioral intention.

articleTitle: Does the financial contagion event impact India's Sustainability?
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The current study examines how the COVID-19 pandemic, viewed as a financial contagion event, may affect the ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) sectors linked to environmental sustainability. According to an empirical study, COVID-19 strongly and favorably affects share price volatility firms included in the ESG index. This study use time series analysis to analysis the data by performing regression in R-programming. The paper's novel method of employing COVID-19 instances as a gauge of financial contagion and its thorough examination of the effects of volatility on the ESG sectors' short- and long-term dynamics are its main contributions. The study empirically supports the positive connection between COVID-19 and environmental variables using the bivariate DCC-GARCH model. The study demonstrates the need for integrated risk management techniques that consider both short-term and long-term environmental attention by highlighting the pandemic's disruptive impact on industries prioritising ecological sustainability. Regulatory agencies and financial institutions should consider including environmental contagion effects in their systemic risk analyses and regulatory frameworks. The study lays the groundwork for ongoing research into pandemic-related issues and sector-specific impact in the changing face of global crises.

articleTitle: Prevention of aggregation of substrate proteins by glyoxal and methylglyoxal without the formation of chemical adducts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Molecular chaperones and small molecule chaperones or chemical chaperones like osmolytes, hydrophobic molecules and pharmacological chaperones are known to prevent protein misfolding by preventing protein aggregation. Studies on the mechanistic insight as to how stabilization and prevention of protein aggregation occur by these chaperones are still the subject of interest. In this study, we derive probable mechanism of two small molecule alpha-oxoaldehydes, glyoxal and methylglyoxal-mediated instantaneous prevention of protein aggregation by simple spectroscopic studies in contrast to previous studies by other workers that were undertaken at very high doses and long incubation periods. Under physiological conditions, both glyoxal and methylglyoxal can prevent chemical and heat-induced aggregation of proteins instantaneously. Unlike detergents, these oxoaldehydes do not solubilize proteins but prevents further aggregation of the proteins. No cross-linked products are detected by mass spectrometry when the oxoaldehydes are incubated with the client proteins for short time. Surface hydrophobicity does not play any role in protection against aggregation of client proteins. It is possible that both the sugar metabolites prevent protein aggregation by mechanical entrapment of the protein within the sugar metabolite molecules thereby forming a scaffold around the protein moieties like trehalose.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Model for Prediction of Heart Failure with Enhanced Self-Supervised Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: In recent times the role artificial intelligence across healthcare has become more significant. The effective convergence of this technique helps in earlier diagnosis and treatment of various harmful diseases. Congestive heart failure mainly caused due to unhealthy life style and various other cardiac factors is a serious healthcare concern among humans that impacts several individuals every year. On the other hand, there are many numbers of researches that attempt to prevent the harmful impacts of the heart failure in human. The major concern with these approaches are that it lacks in sufficient labeled data. In this context, the proposed approach presents an enhanced self-supervised learning algorithm for prediction of heart failure in humans. The major contribution of this approach is to compare the significant factors that contribute to heart failure and to predict the possibility of person’s risk to heart disease in an accurate manner. The accuracy measures are compared with other conventional models based on supervised and unsupervised learning. The simulation results of the proposed approach is found to be comparatively better than the conventional approaches.

articleTitle: Ultra short pulse generation by Gain Switching in Temperature dependent Electrically Pumped Micro disk Lasers for Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Micro-Disk Lasers (MDLs) operating at 1059nm are compact semiconductor devices that utilize whispering gallery modes for optical confinement. The circular geometry of the microdisk allows for high Q-factor resonances, enabling low threshold lasing. The 1059nm wavelength is particularly useful for applications in optical communications and spectroscopy. Fabrication often involves epitaxial growth techniques followed by etching processes to define the disk structure. Recent Studies focus on improving thermal management and integrating these devices with on-chip photonic circuits. Gain switching involves rapidly modulating the laser's gain above and below the lasing threshold using short electrical pulses. This process creates a population inversion followed by a rapid discharge, resulting in picosecond or sub-picosecond optical pulses. In microdisk lasers, the small cavity volume enhances the speed of this process. These devices find applications in optical communications, spectroscopy, and sensing. They're used in wavelength-division multiplexing systems, gas detection (e.g., methane), and as sources for frequency combs. Their compact size makes them suitable for integrated photonic circuits. In bio photonics, they are employed for fluorescence excitation and optical coherence tomography. They also show potential in quantum information processing. This research article focusses on generating ultra short optical pulses from electrically driven MDLs at various temperatures ranging from 25°C to 100°C. The pulse dynamics and other characteristics are discussed in detail in different sections of the article.

articleTitle: Intelligent Model for Smart Waste Detection and Segmentation using YOLO v8
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Object detection is a crucial domain with applications across multiple disciplines. It has demonstrated a significant impact on predicting objects in videos and images. Presently, the majority of cities face the challenge of garbage disposal, making it difficult for humans to segregate waste by category. To tackle this enduring challenge, we propose implementing smart waste detection and segmentation using the YOLOv8 model. Our research focuses on adding categories such as paper, metal, plastic, and others, utilizing the advanced object detection algorithm YOLOv8 for this purpose.

articleTitle: Framework for Engineering the effects of Overthinking in Online Food Ordering Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Consumers have a wide range of options in the modern world, but having more options does not always translate into a better customer experience. As a matter of fact, having too many options can frequently result in overthinking and decision paralysis, which lowers enjoyment. This study examines the impact of an abundance of options on decision paralysis, or overthinking, in the Indian market, with a specific focus on online meal delivery services. This research provides a novel viewpoint on information overload and decision paralysis (overthinking) by filling a significant vacuum in the body of existing material. Data was collected quantitatively from 80 Bangalore-based participants using a variety of established measures. Age appears to be a key component in the strong association between choice overload and decision paralysis (overthinking), as indicated by the results, which were evaluated using t-tests and regression analysis. Gender did not affect decision paralysis (overthinking) or choice overload, which was unexpected. This revelation matters. This research found that food delivery systems must be reformed and simplified to enhance choice architecture, particularly for users under 40. To greatly improve user experience, this is important. This study has larger significance for educational institutions and online firms that want to understand how consumers behave and make decisions online.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Analytics in Internal Audit of Banks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Internal Auditing has a major role in corporate governance of banks. It examines governance systems, risk management and internal control processes. Data from various sources is critical evidence for audits. In the past, data validation, evaluation and analysis were from paper documents and records. Increase in number of customers and scale of operations today, generates "Big Data". Special platforms, software tools, and graph databases are now used for "Big Data Analytics (BDA)". BDA helps early identification of compliance challenges and risks, enabling timely correction. BDA with IOT based ‘continuous audit’ ensures real-time monitoring of financial and other operations. A data-driven audit strategy leads to early detection of latent frauds. This substantially reduces financial misstatements and fraud. The auditor can analyse vast datasets in real-time, making the audit process more efficient and effective for safeguarding financial integrity and compliance. This paper discusses the role of BDA in internal audit of banks, analyses challenges in incorporating BDA and suggests a conceptual framework for implementation.

articleTitle: Impact of Ease of Doing Business Rank on Economic Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The Ease of Doing Business Rank (ER) is an initiative by world bank to have an assessment on how easy it is to do business in an economy based on certain parameters including starting a business, dealing with construction permits, registering property, getting electricity etc. A good doing business rank attracts the investors or business firms to start the business in a particular economy which directly or indirectly affects the GDP stats of that particular region. GDP or Gross domestic product is a very old term in the field of Economics. Despite of the fact that many economists and economics professors have criticized it in different dimensions, its role in public policy and society is still quite influential. The study is an attempt to assess the strength of relationship between the ER rank and GDP of different states and UTs. of India. The data used in this study was gathered from secondary sources. India's 28 states and eight union territories provided the data for this paper. The study's time frame spans from 2015 until 2020. The data sources used in this study are the economic survey, Niti Ayog, and the websites of the RBI. The results of the study shows that there is a positive relationship between ER rank (ER) and GDP. The study concludes with the fact that world bank should continue with evaluating the countries and provide ease of doing ranks which becomes a path-builders for those who are searching for different business or entrepreneurial opportunities.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Data Logging System for Authenticated Bank Locker Access to Ensuring Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: In the conventional method of the banking system, whenever someone visits a bank to access the lockers, there will be a security guard appointed by the bank to ensure that the customer accessing his/her locker is authorized and only accessing his/her locker. Before entering the locker room to access their lockers, the person needs to enter the logbook available at the bank. The proposed system is a data logging system with Near Field Communication (NFC) capability. NFC is used to ensure a person's authentication and logging details. The NFC reader is installed at the entrance to bank lockers. Each customer who wants to utilize a locker is given an NFC tag, and the suggested system saves the customer's basic information as well as the unique NFC tag id assigned to each customer in a MySQL database. The authenticated individual must display the NFC tag near the reader. The reader detects the tag value and compares it to the database. If the customer is authenticated, the electromagnetic locking system will unlock the locker room door. Along with the NFC tag id, additional logging data such as the check-in time and date, as well as the customer's basic information, are simultaneously and automatically logged into a separate database table. Another reader can be installed inside the locker room to record the customers' check-out date and time in a manner similar to the one described above. Automated, authenticated-based entries are created by the system. The customer access time in the locker room can also be calculated with its help.

articleTitle: Gamifying Finance: Enhancing User Engagement and Financial Literacy through Digital Gamification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This research explores how intermediation within FinTech economies is evolving through the integration of video game elements into applications, rather than traditional games. First, we argue that gamification plays a key role in bridging the social and technical aspects of FinTech, highlighting expertise in areas such as behavioral science, digital marketing, and UX/UI design, which are becoming increasingly important for FinTech intermediation. Second, existing studies on advanced producer services (APS) and financial services and technology (FS&T) in the context of FinTech and financial intermediation overlook the specialized firms that are central to gamification. Third, certain game mechanics are being used to create competitive positions in the market, engaging users through continuous gameplay and guiding their behavior, which contrasts with traditional FinTech strategies that focus on simplicity, cost efficiency, and personalized access to products and services. To illustrate these points, we present three case studies of Asian companies that have successfully implemented gamified FinTech applications, a trend that is gaining momentum in the region.

articleTitle: Mitigating Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) Attack on Computer System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This article addresses the performance of ARP attack over a computer network on a particular computer. It covers the implementation of a smarter and an enhanced feature software developed by the authors to mitigate the poisoning attack, which generates dire risky consequences on any network, or computer system that suffers it. The step by step processes employed in executing such a dangerous attack is enumerated sequentially, and a mitigating measure is advised using our software

articleTitle: Comprehensive Examination of Rejuvenating the Education System with Mental Health to Attain Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The psychological well-being of students and the process of educating the human mind are closely connected, yet the existing education system tends to treat this issue with a lack of seriousness. This study aims to investigate the necessity for revitalizing our present educational setting to ensure its long-term viability. The researcher acknowledges this concept and examines how mental health affects students' academic success, their general well-being, and the well-being of their future careers. We anticipate achieving a deeper comprehension of the present condition of mental well-being within the educational framework, pinpointing major stressors affecting learners, and crafting specific strategies to enhance mental health results. These strategies are anticipated to boost academic achievement, diminish mental health challenges, and foster a more nurturing and enduring educational setting. Our objective is to disseminate knowledge and suggestions to policymakers, teachers, and other involved parties committed to constructing a robust and enduring educational framework that prioritizes mental health.

articleTitle: Improving Energy Efficiency in Three-Tier IoT Sensor Networks Through NDFT-based Power Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The data transmission process in the Internet of Things based sensor network is crucial as many applications require data movement from one device to another. As the network size grows, the volume of data transmission increases, reducing the overall energy efficiency of the network and leading to higher communication costs. Additionally, The execution time also increases as a result of this problem. Some researchers work on reducing the communication cost by using the clustering approach but these methods have not fully achieved the desired improvements. This paper explores the implementation of the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) on nonequidistant sensor nodes within a clustered sensor network to address these challenges. The method produces Fourier coefficients with estimation in error limits. Once the clusters become communication cost-efficient, the data routing is performed using the power constraints of the nodes, cluster leaders, and the base station. The nodes in every cluster transmit their measurements to a CL. CLs fuse the signals received by sensor nodes and send them to a base station on orthogonal fading channels. The channel estimation can be done by sending pilot signals to BS from CL. The Bayesian Cramér-Rao bound is obtained from mean square error and linear minimum mean square error estimator at BS. The proposed system demonstrates effective performance across various constraint parameters and proves to be power efficient. It has reduced the transmission cost by 35.2% and execution time by 24.13%.

articleTitle: MarineLens: Empowering Conservation through AI-Powered Fish Species Detection and Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: MarineLens is a groundbreaking conservation tool that leverages the power of artificial intelligence to revolutionize fish species detection and insights in marine environments. Using advanced machine learning algorithms, MarineLens is able to accurately identify and track different fish species, providing researchers and conservationists with valuable data on population dynamics, behavior patterns, and habitat usage. By harnessing the capabilities of AI, this technology offers a cost-effective and efficient solution for monitoring marine life and assessing the impact of human activities on underwater ecosystems. MarineLens enhances the ability to make data-driven decisions and implement targeted conservation strategies to protect vulnerable species and preserve biodiversity. With its user-friendly interface and customizable features, MarineLens empowers users to generate actionable insights and visualize complex data in a comprehensible manner, facilitating collaboration and knowledge sharing within the conservation community. Enabling a proactive approach to marine conservation, MarineLens is a game-changer in safeguarding our oceans for future generations.

articleTitle: Blockchain in E-Commerce: Assessing Key Factors, Consumer Perceptions, and Implementation Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: With the advancement in technology and purchasing methods evolving, the e-commerce industry is experiencing rapid growth and development. E-commerce platforms empower businesses of all sizes to reach a broader audience by selling products and promoting their brands. However, traditional e-commerce faces challenges, including fraud, payment disputes, data security issues, and limited transparency, which, combined with unreliable product information, have weakened consumers’ confidence. This highlights the need for solutions that can enhance transactional transparency and build trust. Blockchain technology offers the feasibility to adapt e-commerce by increasing the security and efficiency of transactions. Through a decentralized network, blockchain allows users to securely store and share digital assets, enabling buyers to verify product details, such as origin and source, while reducing fraud risk. Although blockchain adoption in e-commerce is still emerging, it presents promising benefits. This paper explores the role of block-chain in ecommerce transactions and also the challenges within ecommerce transactions. The study also determines the various factors that affect the use of blockchain in e-commerce transactions. In order to achieve the research objectives, the data was collected using a structured questionnaire and was analyzed by using the statistical tool SPSS 20.0. The data was collected from 178 respondents. Factor Analysis was done using Principal Component Analysis and it was found that there were five factors: confidentiality of data, trust, transparency, willingness and privacy and intricacies which affects the blockchain technology on E commerce transactions for the consumers, with a total of 61.45% variation in the data set. The study shows that the determined factors affect the role of blockchain technology in e-commerce transactions for consumers.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Self-Balancing Robot with Integrated Object Detection Using MobileNetV2 and PID Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of a self-balancing two-wheeled robot capable of detecting hazardous objects in a household environment. The stability issue in two-wheeled robots is addressed using a Proportional Integral Derivative (PID) controller to maintain vertical equilibrium, while object detection is achieved via the MobileNetV2 framework, a convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture. A camera, interfaced with a Raspberry Pi, continuously captures video frames, identifying potentially dangerous objects. Upon detection, both the input frame and the detected object are stored for further analysis. The robot’s balance is maintained through the use of an MPU6050 sensor, which provides feedback on the robot’s angular inclination. This feedback is processed by the PID controller to adjust the direction and speed of the DC motors, ensuring the robot remains upright. The design phase included mechanical system planning, ensuring stability and efficiency in the robot’s operation. The final system integrates both object detection and self-balancing, providing a safe and interactive toy for children. This innovative combination of object detection and self-balancing mechanisms demonstrates the practical application of control theory and computer vision techniques in robotic systems. The system offers insights into the effective integration of PID control and object detection using modern neural network architectures.

articleTitle: Consumer Preferences Towards Online Shopping of Electronic Products
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: In today's environment, consumers are more likely to make purchases that are well-informed and intelligent, which calls for inventive marketing strategies. Internet marketing strategies are undergoing a transformation as a result of the fact that they are more expedient and convenient than traditional marketing techniques when it comes to reaching out to target customers. Electronic goods have been selected for the purpose of this inquiry. The major objective of this research is to explore the link between consumer preferences and demographics. Specifically, the study will focus on customer preferences regarding preferred electronic items, preferred payment methods, and preferred online merchants for the purchase of electronic products. The sample size consisted of four hundred Indian customers who had purchased electronic goods from online shops. During the course of this inquiry, both primary and secondary sources of information were used. For the purpose of analysis, many methods were used, including judgment sampling, chi square, and cross tabulation. According to the findings of the chi square analysis, there is a significant association between the preferences of customers for purchasing electrical devices online and their demographic classifications. The link between consumer preferences and demographics is the subject of this study, which is one of the few studies dealing with the topic. In order to protect themselves from fraudulent transactions, customers will profit from the finding. Furthermore, it will be of assistance to organizations that engage in e-commerce in better comprehending the preferences of their customers and designing their pricing plans.

articleTitle: Integrating IoT for Smart Bus Tracking and Capacity Monitoring: Enhancing the Efficiency of Public Transportation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Public transportation plays a vital role in our society, serving as a primary means of commuting for many. However, passengers often encounter inconveniences and difficulties during their journeys. It would be beneficial to address these issues to enhance the overall transportation experience. This paper aims to propose a solution to common problems faced by passengers when using public transportation. The project introduces the concept of "Know Your Bus," which utilizes sensors (Pressure and Proximity), a microcontroller (Arduino), and GPS (Global Positioning System) technology to provide a solution. Data from these sensors and GPS is transmitted to the microcontroller, which updates a database. This information is then made available to the public via a website accessible by passengers. "Know Your Bus" offers valuable insights such as the number of available seats and real-time status updates for buses, enabling passengers to make informed decisions when choosing their transportation options. Furthermore, the implementation of our concept not only improves the passenger experience but also contributes to more efficient and sustainable urban transportation systems. It presents a smart solution to the challenges faced when using public transport.

articleTitle: Time Reduction Analysis Based on Infill Pattern on FDM 3D Printed PLA Material
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) used in 3D Printing is a widely used additive manufacturing technology known for its versatility and cost-effectiveness. One critical quality attribute of FDM 3D printing is the infill pattern, which directly affects the mechanical properties, print quality, and production time of printed parts. This paper focuses on analyzing the impact of different infill patterns on time consumption in FDM 3D print time duration. The research methodology involves designing and printing test specimens with varying infill patterns, including but not limited to grid, honeycomb, and gyroid Printing parameters such as layer height, infill density, and print speed are kept constant to isolate the effect of infill patterns on print time. A comprehensive analysis is conducted to measure the print time for each infill pattern and evaluate their influence on the overall printing duration.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing Consumers' Attitude for Adoption of Electric Vehicles in India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: In recent years, the global automotive landscape has witnessed a paradigm shift with an increasing emphasis on sustainability and the reduction of carbon emissions. One of the most promising solutions to address environmental concerns is the widespread adoption of electric vehicles (EVs). The shift to electric transportation in India is accelerating due to governmental initiatives, rising environmental consciousness, and technological developments. As India endeavours to establish itself as a leader in the worldwide movement towards environmentally conscious transportation, it is vital to comprehend the variables impacting customers' perspectives on the uptake of electric cars. This study is an effort to analyse the factors of adoption of electric vehicles by consumers of Delhi and NCR.

articleTitle: Consumer Feedback Analysis on iPhones: EDA and NLP Model Comparison for Sentiment Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The current study assesses consumers’ attitude and their responses to iPhone products using EDA and performance comparison of different NLP models. An Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on a real set of Amazon reviews to analyze rating distribution, as well as the frequency of various aspects present in customer reviews in being performed. Afterwards a logistic regression, SVM, and LSTM with accuracies of 86%, 87%, and 88% respectively to predict review sentiment is conducted. The results of each model are presented in terms of accuracy, precision and recall to show how well each model can identify positive and negative sentiments accurately. The results presented the study provides important information about consumer perceptions and the potential performance of various models when processing textual data relevant to this context. From this study, there are rich implications for both consumer behaviour analysis and sentiment classification which may be used in the context of product review analysis.

articleTitle: A Novel LLM enabled Code Snippet Generation Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) represent a breakthrough in natural language processing (NLP), leveraging deep learning techniques to achieve exceptional proficiency in code generation, analysis and modification of human languages. These models, characterized by their vast scale and parameter count, like Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT by Google) and the Generative Pre-trained Transformer series (by OpenAI’s GPT), have revolutionized various applications including text generation, translation, summarization, and question answering. In our paper we investigate the practicality,complications, and significance of using LLMs for code generation. We provide a review analysis of existing LLM models in use and compare their proficiency for code generation. This paper examines the underlying mechanisms of LLMs, specially their ability to grasp the code syntax, semantics, and programming logic from large-scale repositories and their documentations. The models’ training techniques include fine-tuning programming-specific datasets and enhancing the models' competency to generate code snippets that are syntactically correct and contextually relevant.

articleTitle: Leveraging Smart Computing for Effective Crime Spot Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The mingling of various edge based models of the Internet of Things (IoT) proposes a fanatical methodology for criminal activity deduction along with public safety. This article investigates the creation and deployment of an edge computing-based, Internet of Things-based framework designed to transfer real-time crime spot threats. The suggested system uses a grids of interlinked resources and devices to gather and analyzing provincial data, reducing latency and improving alert system timeliness. Edge computing certify data analysis at the group site, enabling immediate recognition of questionable behaviour and well timely reporting to the legal authorities. Our system’s architecture illustrates consistence performance all over while nurturing end-to-end data encryption& data protection measures. This innovative approach to deployment of IoT networks and enabled sensors establishes intelligent urban security which would enhance more secure environments.

articleTitle: Enhancing Fault Detection and Diagnosis through an Integrated Chaos-RNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: One of the most challenging problems is to identify the anomaly or fault in machines and materials, though identifying the faults are a tedious task once the fault or anomaly is identified. Identifying the reason or the root cause for the fault or anomaly is the expected or actual solution for the problem. Smart manufacturing based on Digital Twin has provided solutions for several non-trivial problems such as detecting the time taken for product delivery, fault detection in materials, machines, delivery and many more real time problems. To detect the anomaly real-time and identify or reason out the root cause behind the fault a novel digital twin architecture comprising of several novel modules is proposed; improving the productivity of the outcome from manufacturing. A Digital Twin architecture for identifying the Root Cause of a Fault in a Smart Manufacturing environment based on Anomaly Detection and Time Series analysis is proposed. The architecture is expected to improve the overall production rate and reduce the down time in identifying the root cause of the fault occurred. An Artificial Neural Network that works on the principle of Chaos Theory is proposed and experimented with single and multi-class anomaly.

articleTitle: Financial Inclusion through Fintech Services in Saudi Arabia: Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This research examines the impact of financial technology (fintech) services on financial inclusion (FI) in Saudi Arabia. The findings indicate that fintech services positively contribute to FI. Specifically, access to mobile money services, mobile money products, perceived usefulness, and the intention to continue using fintech services have a significant positive impact. While perceived convenience, ease of use, and attitude toward fintech services also have a positive influence, these effects are not statistically significant.The study emphasizes the crucial role of mobile products in enhancing FI through fintech services. These findings provide valuable insights for fintech service providers and banks, suggesting they should prioritize the development and promotion of mobile-based fintech services. This could involve investments in mobile banking apps, expanding mobile money networks, and improving the accessibility and usability of mobile platforms. The implications of these findings are discussed from both theoretical and practical perspectives.

articleTitle: Exploring Diverse Approaches to Detect and Diagnose Breast Cancer through Medical Imaging Modalities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Breast cancer is a widespread and transformative illness that necessitates early identification and accurate diagnosis to achieve the best possible results for patients. Medical imaging methods are integral in the entire spectrum of breast cancer care, covering detection, characterization, and staging. This comprehensive review investigates various imaging technologies' strengths, limitations, and emerging patterns, including mammography, breast ultrasound, breast MRI, molecular imaging (PET/CT, scintimammography, MBI), and cutting-edge innovations. Through an examination of elements such as sensitivity, specificity, safety, cost-effectiveness, and patient accessibility, this study directs clinical decision-making, emphasizing the significance of a multimodal approach in the management of breast cancer. The abstract provides insight into the meticulous evaluation of these methods and their implications for improving the accuracy and efficacy of breast cancer diagnosis, ultimately contributing to advancements in patient care and outcomes.

articleTitle: Blockchain Nexus: Converging Blockchain with IOT, Healthcare and Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Lithium battery technology and blockchain have the potential to transform various industries, including IoT, cybersecurity, and healthcare. In IoT, blockchain enhances security by providing a decentralized ledger that enables secure device communication and transactions without a central authority. In cybersecurity, blockchain fortifies defenses against breaches and data manipulation through encrypted transactions and consensus-based validation, improving data integrity and incident response. In healthcare, blockchain facilitates secure exchange of patient records, gives patients control over their data, and enhances pharmaceutical supply chain transparency by tracking drug provenance, reducing counterfeit drugs and improving patient safety. These technological advancements demonstrate the revolutionary impact of lithium batteries and blockchain in addressing significant challenges in post-Internet environments.

articleTitle: Strategic Approach for Integrating Legal Compliance into Engineering Project Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: According to the analysis of the study, compliance with the law is necessary in order to successfully complete engineering projects. It is possible that proactive compliance monitoring will be advantageous throughout the whole of the project, beginning with the planning phase and continuing through post-completion audits. It's possible that this will reduce the risk, as well as the cost and the amount of time. For the purpose of examining the connection between compliance and project performance, this study makes use of both qualitative and quantitative research approaches. The performance metrics, which include labor laws, safety ratings, and environmental ratings, are the primary focus of the study. Early compliance promotes both the long-term viability of the project and its efficiency. There is a possibility that this may be accomplished by fostering trust among stakeholders and promoting sustainability.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Machine Learning Models for Kidney Stone Classification Using HOG Features on CT Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Kidney stones, or renal calculi, represent hard mineral and salt deposits which are formed in the kidneys and may cause intense pain, infections of the urinary tracts, and other complications. Machine learning techniques are commonly applied to the problem of kidney stone classification, as this task is critical in medical imaging and contributes to correct diagnosis and treatment. This work aims to evaluate the performance of Gradient Boost, XGBoost, AdaBoost, and CatBoost models when processing a set of kidney CT images organized in Cyst, Normal, Stone, and Tumor classes. The initial dataset, available on Kaggle, is placed in the public domain and includes grayscale images resized to 128×128 pixels: these images are further processed using Histograms of Oriented Gradients. It was found that although AdaBoost achieved high precision for Cysts, lower overall accuracy (0.71) and variable performance, particularly in Stone classification, were observed. Conversely, XGBoost, Gradient Boosting, and CatBoost demonstrated near-perfect accuracy (0.99) and ROC values of 1.00 across all categories, with CatBoost showing especially consistent performance. The superior classification capabilities of XGBoost, Gradient Boosting, and CatBoost for kidney stone identification were highlighted, emphasizing the importance of selecting ML models based on detailed performance metrics. Future research may focus on optimizing these models or enhancing feature extraction methods.

articleTitle: Human-Artificial Intelligence Synergy (AI): Leveraging Generative AI(GAI) to Empower the IT Workforce
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The study investigates the human-AI synergy on performance within the IT sector workforce, focusing on generative AI (GAI) tools. Adopting the Task-Technology Fit Theory, the research evaluates how AI characteristics (adaptivity, iteration capabilities, learning ability, quality of content) and human traits (self-efficacy, personal innovativeness) influence AI reliance and performance outcomes. A sample survey of 148 middle-level IT employees reveals that AI reliance significantly enhances performance through improved task knowledge validation and higher self-efficacy. While AI’s adaptive and iterative features do not substantially impact reliance, task knowledge validation, and personal innovativeness emerge as crucial factors. The findings highlight the importance of integrating AI effectively into task processes and supporting employee confidence to optimize performance. This research contributes in understanding AI’s role in workplace efficiency and suggests areas for future exploration, including industry-wide studies and qualitative assessments of AI reliance.

articleTitle: Sustainability of the Hot Springs Tourism In Nepal
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Travelers go to hot springs because of the positive effects they have on their health, spirituality, and leisure. Hot springs that are geothermal are formed naturally. In spite of the fact that Nepal is home to a number of hot springs and geographical circumstances that are suitable, the country's potential is being hampered by a lack of research and accessibility. One of the various components of tourism was investigated in Nepal via the use of a mixed-methods research that looked at the viability of hot springs as a tourist attraction. Sixty participants from six distinct hot spring locations were interviewed in a semi-structured format for the purpose of conducting content analysis for this research. Data analysis was the objective of the activity. It is important to highlight the advantages of wellness and health services, since the results of the survey indicate that the majority of visitors are there for therapeutic and medical objectives. As a result of the increased number of visitors and the desire to promote environmentally responsible travel, the respondents believe that there is an immediate need for more infrastructure. To ensure the continued success of Nepal's hot spring tourism business, it is essential that the study emphasizes the need of sustainable management. A preference for ecotourism and health tourism is also detected by the survey.

articleTitle: Deep Learning and its Applications: A Novel Approach to Machine Learning with Encoding Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Deep learning has revolutionized data processing by recognizing complicated patterns using multi-layered neural networks. Encoding complex data like hyperspectral photos may help deep learning models perform better. Encoding shapes raw data for compression, dimensionality reduction, and feature extraction. These methods matter. This research found that higher-dimensional encodings can improve deep learning model accuracy and convergence. Complex encoding algorithms like FE-16D and BLOSUM-20D outperform simpler ones in validation accuracy and AUC. To prove this, extensive testing and comparison were done. The study emphasizes the necessity to combine deep learning frameworks with improved encoding techniques to improve machine learning and large-scale data processing.

articleTitle: Training & Competency Mapping: Focus on Learning & Mentoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: In today's fast-paced and continuously evolving business environment, organizations must ensure that their workforce remains competent and adaptable. This study focuses on the online sales department of a mid-sized company in Noida, India, and explores the effectiveness of training need identification (TNI) and training transfer (TT) processes in enhancing employee performance. Action research methodology was employed, involving both qualitative and quantitative assessments to evaluate these processes. The research began with a comprehensive job analysis to identify the essential competencies required for effective performance in online sales roles. This was followed by mapping the existing competencies of employees, particularly those whose performance had been subpar over the past three months (n=57). A detailed gap analysis was conducted, comparing the required competencies with the current skill levels. Subsequently, to address the identified gaps, a tailored training program was developed, incorporating modern learning techniques such as online learning e-modules and microlearning & training effectiveness was assessed. This research highlights the importance of accurate TNI and effective TT in driving employee performance improvements. It contributes to the existing literature by providing insights into how competency mapping and modern learning techniques can be effectively applied in a mid- sized, resource-constrained organization. The findings offer practical implications for similar companies aiming to enhance their training and development processes.

articleTitle: Expression Analysis of Tweets using NLP in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Nowadays the social media has become one of the most essential platforms for reviewing and commenting their own opinions and perspectives. Sentiment analysis is the study of analyzing reviews of the people from texts, products and also analyzing the customer opinions. Expression or Sentiment analysis uses machine learning concepts particularly Natural Language Processing and various ML algorithms. Mining of the data helps to draw conclusions from various fields. We have proposed a paper where we analyze the sentiments of twitter data, identify and segregate positive tweets and negative tweets using machine learning and displaying the number of positive and negative tweets, plotting them using histogram and displaying the classification report. We have done this project since it is one of the most important tasks of classifying the positive and negative texts and analyze the sentiments which is very crucial for any organization’s growth

articleTitle: Intelligent and Innovative Approaches to Delivering Social Welfare Schemes in India: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence for Public Impact
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) adoption is growing rapidly across sectors, yet significant barriers hinder its acceptance in Indian government social welfare schemes. This research investigates factors influencing AI adoption using a mixed-methods approach, including the Delphi method with 13 experts and a survey of 146 respondents. The study identifies five key themes from a systematic literature review: social environment, organizational issues, technology-related issues, technology ecosystem, and individual factors. Concerns highlighted include data privacy, security vulnerabilities, trust in AI’s transparency, and a perceived lack of accountability in AI decision-making amongst others.Despite these concerns, the study reveals areas where respondents are comfortable using AI, particularly in healthcare, finance, and customer service sectors, suggesting a conditional acceptance based on context. The findings emphasize that addressing both technological and human factors— such as trust, security, and transparency is critical for fostering AI acceptance in Social Welfare schemes by Governments in India.By addressing these barriers and leveraging areas of comfort, policymakers can promote AI integration in social welfare schemes. This research contributes to existing literature by offering insights into user perceptions, with implications for theory, practice, and policy. Future research should focus on longitudinal studies to track shifts in public attitudes as AI technologies evolve.

articleTitle: IT Applications in New Product Development through Value Co-Creation: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Even though they are still relatively new, new product development (NPD) techniques were first defined in great depth for the first time in the 1980s. This was the first time NPD approaches were described. When it comes to conceptual development, it might be challenging to build a consistent strategy due to the fact that every product that is being developed is different. Information technology (IT) is the umbrella word that encompasses all computer systems. The capabilities of information technology are advancing, and businesses are beginning to take use of these advancements in order to foster creativity and bring about the creation of new products. The process of presenting unique items to the market is referred to as new product development, and it is a rigorous procedure. By following this approach, the objective is to guarantee that the commodities will continue to be important. If companies wish to maintain their edge over their competitors, they must continually devise new ways to innovate and adapt to the ever-evolving requirements of their customers. In order to evaluate the impact of information technology applications on the process of generating new items via value co-creation, a research study was carried out with the participation of 209 company representatives from a variety of departments. As a consequence of the value co-creation process, it was discovered that applications of information technology had a major impact on the manufacture of new items.

articleTitle: AI based Bridging Disciplines between LAW, AI, Management and Psychology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across various disciplines has revolutionized traditional practices and expanded research horizons, particularly in fields such as law, management, and psychology. This paper explores the transformative potential of AI in bridging these disciplines, highlighting its impact on decision-making, operations optimization, and understanding human behavior. By examining the intersection of these fields, we uncover the multidimensional impacts of AI, from ethical considerations and legal frameworks to management theories and psychological practices. Through an interdisciplinary approach, this study aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of AI's role in modern academia and industry, emphasizing the importance of developing AI applications that are ethical, effective, and beneficial across diverse fields.

articleTitle: Relation Assessment of Corporate Social Responsibility and Environmental Sustainability: Beneficiaries Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The essence of corporate social responsibility (CSR) in business lies in how companies integrate societal and environmental considerations into their operations. Given that these stakeholders can influence company activities, it is essential for firms to engage with them in ways that are environmentally and socially responsible. This study aims to explore the significant environmental impacts of CSR initiatives in Uttar Pradesh from the perspectives of beneficiaries of selected public and private CSR projects. Original data was collected through structured questionnaires distributed to 500 beneficiaries. The gathered data will be analyzed using SPSS software version 25, focusing on frequency analysis, exploratory factor analysis, correlation examination, and regression analysis. The analysis revealed a strong positive relationship between the extent of CSR practices and their environmental impact. The findings underscore the critical role of business actions and initiatives in fostering beneficial environmental outcomes. Companies can effectively contribute to environmental stewardship through the adoption of sustainable practices, as perceived by the beneficiaries. This study aims to address an underexplored issue or provide a novel perspective on an existing one, contributing empirical evidence to the field through firsthand data from beneficiaries, which can guide future research on the impacts of CSR practices on environmental concerns.

articleTitle: Responsible AI based Cointegration and Causality between Cryptocurrency and Traditional Stock Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This study examines the dynamic interaction between stock markets and cryptocurrency exchanges using a number of characteristics. This work’s primary objective is to comprehend their cointegration and causal relationships. Artificial intelligence is being used in this endeavour to monitor sector activities. The importance of digital assets in the global financial ecosystem is growing. The goal of this study is to enhance investment possibilities and risk management in the dynamic financial landscape. Over time, it is anticipated that the connections among these elements will become more significant.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of Perceived Utility and Perceived Ease of Use on Attitude of the HRMS Software Users
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The aim of this research is to examine the manner in which attributes like perceived utility and perceived simplicity of use affect users' opinions of the Human Resource Management System (HRMS) and how these attributes affect users' attitudes. The primary goal of this inquiry is to ascertain the legality of the techniques used in human resource management. The aim of this study is to examine the degree to which users' opinions of the human resource management system (HRMS) are influenced by how useful and user-friendly they thought the system was. The Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) has been used as the theoretical foundation for an inquiry into the relationship between attitude, perceived usefulness, and perceived ease of use. One hundred residents of Delhi's National Capital Region have already responded to the standard questionnaires used for the first round of data collection. Within the framework that was created for each separately, the validity and reliability of the surveys are taken into account. The CFA was used in order to validate the criterion. The research's results support the notion that there is a strong relationship between the different component types.

articleTitle: Innovative Practices for Reliable Tuberculosis Detection with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: A bacterial infection is the primary cause of the chronic lung disease tuberculosis, among the ten most common causes of death. Because it may be fatal, TB must be accurately and promptly detected. The identification and treatment of the problem caused by TB require the accurate detection of the disease using image pre-processing, Deep learning, picture segmentation, and data augmentation categorization using X-ray pictures of the chest. Before being employed for transfer learning, the initial weights of nine distinct deep CNN's (ResNet18, ResNet50, ResNet101, Chex Net, InceptionV3, Vgg19, DenseNet201, Squeeze Net, and Mobile Net) were trained, validated, and tested for TB and non-TB case detection.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Examination of Machine Learning Methods for Predicting Software Errors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive examination of machine learning methods for predicting software errors, emphasizing the importance of algorithm selection, data quality, and class imbalance in the development process. The study analyzes various machine learning classifiers— including Support Vector Machine (SVM), C4.5, Logistic Regression (LR), Ripper, Instance-Based learner (IBk), Random Forest (RF), and Naive Bayes (NB)—and evaluates their performance under varying conditions of data imbalance, measured by the Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC). The findings reveal significant variability in classifier performance, highlighting the challenges associated with predictive modeling in imbalanced datasets. The research contributes to the field of software engineering by proposing a framework for integrating machine learning into software development workflows, aiming to enhance software reliability and mitigate the impact of errors in production environments.

articleTitle: Optimization Quality of Dark Web Legal Perspectives Based on Women Influence in the Unorganized Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The Dark Web, characterized by its anonymity and encrypted environment, poses significant challenges and risks, particularly for vulnerable populations such as women in the unorganized sector. This paper investigates the multifaceted impact of the Dark Web on these women, focusing on economic opportunities, exploitation risks, and the legal frameworks designed to address these issues. Through a comprehensive literature review, qualitative case studies, expert interviews, and an analysis of international and domestic legal instruments, this study reveals the complex interplay between technology, law, and social vulnerabilities. It highlights the dual nature of the Dark Web as a potential economic enabler and a facilitator of exploitation. The findings underscore the need for robust legal protections, ethical considerations, and proactive policies to safeguard and empower women in the digital age. By addressing these challenges through a legal and ethical lens, this research contributes to the broader discourse on technology, law, and social justice, advocating for a more equitable and secure digital future.

articleTitle: IOT based Machine Learning Algorithms for Data Science on Quality Control Process
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Because of the combination of Internet of Things (IoT) technology and machine learning (ML) algorithms, quality control methods in the industrial sector are undergoing a revolution. This is because real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, and anomaly detection are now entirely feasible. Conventional quality control methods, which often rely on random inspections and sampling, are being phased out in favour of these cutting-edge technologies, which provide continuous data collection and analysis. The purpose of this research is to get a better understanding of how it is possible for IoT and ML to enhance quality control by examining their applications, benefits, and challenges in industrial settings. In this work, we demonstrate how machine learning algorithms that are based on the Internet of Things (IoT) have the potential to significantly improve defect detection rates, reduce downtime, and optimise manufacturing processes by using a multidimensional research approach that combines empirical analysis and case studies. The findings illustrate how these technologies have a considerable and beneficial impact on decision-making in data-driven quality control processes, as well as on the efficiency of operations and the quality of products available.

articleTitle: Digital Supply chain Integration: Unleashing the Power of Technology to Enhance Supply chain Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The objective of the study is to develop a comprehensive scale and empirical validation of the model as an instrument for validity assessment of Digital Supply Chain Management (DSCM) dimensions by considering decision factors in determining supply performance. Based on the study of Indian production facilities, this paper studies five supply chain performance attributes: reliability and responsiveness for operational vs strategic perspectives; agility for flexible operations; cost as a management approach to identifying key processes potentially impacting costs at multiple levels within a system and assets utilisation for managing resources. The data were collected by a structured questionnaire from 152 employees to support the literature-based model investigating DSCM processes and their performance areas. The data was processed through Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) and Factor Analysis as an important implication for supply chain managers and researchers interested in optimising performance measures in the Indian manufacturing domain.

articleTitle: Innovative Approach for Global Health Governance in the Post-Pandemic Era
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The COVID-19 crisis has exposedcrucial gaps in global health governance, necessitating a reevaluation of existing structures and strategies in the post-pandemic era. This research paper examines the multifaceted challenges facing global health governance following the pandemic, including inequitable vaccine distribution, strained healthcare systems, and geopolitical tensions. Drawing upon existing literature and empirical evidence, it explores potential avenues for reform to strengthen global health governance. These include enhancing international cooperation through improved coordination mechanisms, bolstering health system resilience through increased investment and capacity-building, and advancing equitable access to essential health technologies and services. Furthermore, the paper underscores the importance of leveraging digital health technologies and innovative financing mechanisms to enhance preparedness and response capacities. By addressing these challenges and embracing opportunities for reform, global health governance can better protect populations worldwide from future health threats in the post-pandemic era.

articleTitle: Analysis on Existing Secure Binary Barriers: Navigating Transgender Rights In Digital Sphere
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This study explores the intersection of artificial intelligence (AI) and transgender rights in the digital age, examining both the potential benefits and risks posed by AI technologies. As AI increasingly permeates sectors such as healthcare, social media, and legal systems, its impact on marginalized communities, particularly transgender individuals, becomes critical to evaluate. AI holds promise in enhancing transgender rights through personalized healthcare, improved social media inclusivity, and streamlined gender legal recognition. However, significant challenges include AI biases perpetuating societal inequities and the underrepresentation of transgender voices in AI development.
