Ethical considerations and collaboration among stakeholders—engineers, policymakers, activists, and the transgender community—are essential to mitigate these risks and foster an inclusive digital environment.

articleTitle: Framework for Securing Quality Control Process in Engineering Using IOT based Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Stochastic Volatility Modelling: A Comparative Analysis with Black-Scholes and Binomial Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This paper presents an in-depth comparative analysis of option pricing models, specifically focusing on the Black-Scholes, Binomial, and AI-enhanced Stochastic Volatility models. While traditional models such as Black-Scholes and Binomial have been extensively used for option pricing, they encounter limitations in capturing stochastic volatility, which is a key characteristic of real-world financial markets. To address this challenge, we integrate machine learning techniques, particularly Random Forests, into the stochastic volatility model to enhance its predictive power and accuracy.Through a series of experiments, we assess the performance of these models based on pricing accuracy, volatility prediction, error metrics (Mean Absolute Error and Root Mean Square Error), and computational efficiency. The results indicate that AI-enhanced models significantly improve volatility predictions and option pricing accuracy compared to traditional models. Additionally, we explore the trade-offs between computational complexity and accuracy, providing valuable insights into the practicality of deploying AI-enhanced models in financial markets. These findings highlight the potential of AI-driven methodologies in advancing the field of quantitative finance and offer promising directions for future research.

articleTitle: Is Artificial Intelligence Transforming the CRM (Customer Relationship) Experience? An Empirical Study in Indian Retail Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The environment of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) is rapidly evolving with substantial developments. Leading businesses are progressively applying automation and artificial intelligence technologies to understand buying behavior of customers, improve brand communication, and enhance relationships. Modern CRM systems generates extensive data sets on customer interactions and behaviors, which AI algorithms analyze to reveal hidden insights on individual preferences, future behaviors, and personalized cross-sell recommendations. AI-driven automation simplifies CRM processes, enabling businesses to personalize interactions, promptly respond to inquiries, and build loyalty. By consistently attracting and meeting customer needs, businesses increase customer value and foster stronger relationships. This paper delves into AI's pivotal role in enhancing CRM, specifically within the retail sector. The blend of machine learning and artificial intelligence has transformed CRM software. These technologies empower businesses to delve deeper into their customers' behaviors and preferences, automate repetitive tasks, and offer highly personalized experiences. For instance, ML algorithms can sift through extensive customer data, uncover patterns, and forecast future behaviors, allowing companies to customize their offerings and marketing approaches accordingly. AI-driven chatbots can deliver immediate customer support, addressing queries and resolving issues promptly, even beyond regular business hours. This piece examines the crucial impact of ML and AI in elevating CRM software capabilities. Sample of 213 people from Indian retail industry were considered for survey to know the "impact of Artificial Intelligence Transforming the CRM (Customer Relationship) Experience in Indian Retail Industry". It can be concluded that there is significant influence of Artificial Intelligence Transforming the CRM (Customer Relationship) Experience in Indian Retail Industry.

articleTitle: Hybrid TFT-GRU Time Series Models Optimized by PSO: An Advanced Approach for Financial Data Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Accurate financial time series prediction is a key challenge in modern quantitative finance, directly influencing decision-making and strategy development. In reply to this challenge, researchers recommend an innovative hybrid model that cartels the strengths of the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) models for financial data prediction. The TFT is created for interpretable multi-horizon forecasting and can capture both short- and long-term relationships in time series data, while GRU excels in efficiently handling sequential data with lower computational complexity associated to more traditional recurrent models like LSTMs. This hybrid method influences the unique advantages of both TFT and GRU to build a more robust and flexible predictive model.To advance the precision and efficiency of the hybrid TFT-GRU model, we employ Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) for hyperparameter tuning. PSO, a nature-inspired optimization algorithm, is used to optimize key parameters such as learning rate and batch size, which directly impact the performance of the model. The PSO algorithm efficiently searches the hyperparameter space by simulating the social behavior of particles in a swarm, leading to faster convergence on optimal solutions. This integration of PSO ensures that the hybrid model is both highly accurate and computationally efficient.The TFT-GRU-PSO hybrid model is tested on actual financial data, which includes datasets of stock prices. Experimental findings demonstrate that our model surpasses conventional approaches in terms of forecasting accuracy, as evaluated by Mean Squared Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and consistency in prediction. This research introduces an advanced approach to financial time series forecasting, demonstrating that hybrid deep learning models combined with optimization techniques like PSO provide a powerful tool for improving prediction in volatile and complex financial markets.

articleTitle: Framework for Securing Quality Control Process in Engineering Using IOT based Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The study aims to investigate how combining many technologies may improve the scalability, adaptability, and security of network engineering systems. Some of the technologies that come under this category include the Internet of Things (IoT), Network Function Virtualization (NFV), Machine Learning (ML), and Software Defined Networking (SDN). Examining potential effective merger strategies for these technologies is one of the study's objectives. Our study has shown that our approach improves organizational effectiveness, defect finding, and engineering productivity. articleTitle: Integrated IoT-Based Smart Home Security System: Real-Time Hazard Detection and Alerts Using Multi-Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative IoT-based smart home security system that integrates multiple sensors to detect various hazards and provide real-time alerts. Unlike traditional single-function systems, this solution combines motion detection via a PIR sensor, gas leak detection using an MQ-2 sensor, and fire detection through an IR flame sensor into a single, affordable package. The Arduino UNO serves as the central controller, interfaced with a GSM module for instantaneous SMS notifications and supported by an on-site buzzer alarm. Extensive testing in diverse environments demonstrates the system’s exceptional performance, detecting intrusions in under 2 seconds and reporting threats with approximately 89% accuracy, while minimizing false alarms. The integration of smart power management techniques reduces energy consumption compared to conventional systems. This approach not only enhances home security but also offers a scalable and easily deployable solution for both residential and commercial settings. This work addresses the urgent need for an affordable, multi-functional smart home security system and provides a robust framework for future IoT-driven safety solutions.

articleTitle: A comprehensive survey, management and market strategies for the optimal pricing of electric vehicle battery

articleTitle: Enhancing Diffuser Augmented Wind Turbine Performance Using CFD Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Increasing the efficiency of wind turbines is crucial if we are going to be effective in combating climate change and reducing the amount of fossil fuels that are currently being used. The electricity that is generated by wind is one of the most important forms of renewable energy. The objective of this study is to investigate the use of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) in order to achieve the highest possible level of performance from diffuser augmented wind turbines (DAWTs). articleTitle: AI and Intellectual Property Law: Challenges and Opportunities in Digital Age
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping the landscape of intellectual property (IP) law, presenting both significant challenges and opportunities. As AI systems increasingly generate creative works and innovations autonomously, traditional IP frameworks— historically centred around human creators and inventors— are being tested. This paper explores the impact of AI on IP law, focusing on authorship and ownership issues, the patentability of AI-generated inventions, and the role of AI in enhancing IP management and protection. Utilizing a qualitative methodology that combines doctrinal legal research and semi-structured interviews, the study identifies key legal ambiguities and gaps, highlights expert consensus on the need for regulatory adaptation, and examines the potential for AI to improve IP management through advanced analytics and automation. Findings underscore the necessity for evolving legal frameworks to address the unique challenges posed by AI while fostering innovation and ensuring fair protection of IP rights.

articleTitle: Financial Literacy and Mindfulness through Innovative Technologies – Path to Financial Independence and Success
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Achieving financial independence and success requires a combination of financial understanding and mindfulness. This study examines the relationship between financial literacy and mindfulness, looking at how combining the two can help people make wise financial decisions, deal with money problems, and create a stable financial future. The methodology for introducing interactive and engaging components into financial education programmes is based on the ideas of gamification, which is the practice of combining entertainment and education to improve learning outcomes. Financial literacy and mindfulness education can effectively equip people with the knowledge, skills, and attitudes required for financial independence and success by exposing learners to real-world scenarios, encouraging collaboration and competition, offering feedback and evaluation, and providing clear progression paths and incentives. This study aims to provide insights and suggestions for individuals, leaders, and educators who wish to encourage better financial well-being in the rapid financial environment of today through a thorough examination of these ideas and tactics. The goal of this research is to address the knowledge gap between conventional financial education and the development of future technologies, including AI. The aim is to create the road for people to thrive in a constantly changing financial world, ensuring their long-term financial success and well-being, by combining these innovative technologies with the concepts of financial literacy and mindfulness.

articleTitle: Psychological Perspectives on AI Regulations in Legal Contexts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This paper explores the psychological dimensions of artificial intelligence (AI) regulations within legal frameworks, examining how cognitive biases, perceptions of risk, and trust influence the adoption and efficacy of AI technologies in the legal domain. By integrating insights from psychology, law, and technology, this study aims to illuminate the complex interplay between human psychological responses and regulatory practices, proposing a framework that balances technological advancement with ethical considerations and societal values. The research methodology includes a mixed-methods approach, encompassing literature review, case studies, and empirical data analysis to provide a comprehensive understanding of the challenges and opportunities presented by AI in legal contexts.

articleTitle: Exploring Higher Education Student Intentions Towards IOT enabled E-Learning Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This study examines how the Internet of Things (IoT) affects e-learning among higher education students. For the purpose of determining whether or not e-learning is acceptable, this study investigates institutions, culture, people, and technology. Several factors are considered, including educational help, self-confidence, and ease of use of technology resources. The research found that students are more inclined to utilize these platforms when the Internet of Things is readily accessible, simple to use, and beneficial to their academic success. This will boost student use of these sites. Using institutional support and focusing on environmental preservation might improve acceptance. This optimizes results. When these facts are considered, educational institutions may be able to develop effective internet of things programs. This increases the focus on environmentally responsible education and improves education quality.

articleTitle: Lean Manufacturing and Efficiency Optimization Case Study of An Indian EV Automotive Manufacturing Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: "Triumph of the Lean Production System" by John Krafcik in 1988 marked the beginning of a radically new outlook towards improving productivity and quality. Since then, lean philosophy has been imbibed into the work culture of several organizations across the world including Toyota, Nissan, Caterpillar Inc., etc., As the automotive world moves towards EV (electric vehicles) it is more than relevant to gather insights on the application of the lean management philosophy in a EV production unit. This paper undertakes a longitudinal study on the production data from an Indian automaker's EV subsidiary. The variables considered include labor hours per unit, machine uptime, defect rates, first-pass yield percentages, production cycle time, and inventory levels. Study results show that equipment maintenance, resource utilization, and rate of defects have improved for the better over the last four years. But quality and inventory turnover were inconsistent during the inspection. The patterns illustrate operational challenges that affect production efficiency and ways to enhance it. Practically, it implies that by using lean manufacturing that aid efficiency, firms may optimize resource allocation, simplify manufacturing, and increase product quality. The uniqueness of this study lies in the longitudinal study with specific focus on electric car manufacturing efficiency. In fast-changing electric car manufacturing, this study shows how lean methods may ensure optimization. The limitation of the study stems from measurements at only one company and ignoring economic and financial factors and hence can be extended to an empirical study of more companies.

articleTitle: Advanced Security Model for Cloud Infrastructure Using Cryptography and Steganography
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Cloud computing offers an infrastructure for individual to business with fluctuating workloads by enabling clients to use resources such as memory, software, hardware, bandwidth etc., on "pay on use" method. Security is a very big challenge when we are dealing with third party services/ cloud infrastructures. Improving the security of data stored on cloud infrastructure is the primary goal of this article. It is achieved by incorporating the features of cryptographic and steganographic techniques. The proposed system introduces a two-level security framework involving cryptographic and steganographic modules. The proposed cryptography module provided improved information security with reduced computational complexity by addressing the challenges of traditional encryption methods. Natural Language Processing (NLP) is used to classify data into segments requiring different levels of security. High-security segments are encrypted using higher end cryptography algorithms like AES, while lower-security segments use simpler methods like substitution techniques. It results in reduced computational complexity. The proposed system further secures the data with the help of steganography. It embedded the encrypted information over the images using the YUV color model, specifically manipulating the brightness component to conceal the data. This combined strategy ensures effective and safe cloud data storage by providing strong security with little computational overhead. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the existing method in the context of better computational complexity, image quality index and embedded and extraction time in evaluating the stego image.

articleTitle: Corporate Social Responsibility on Financial Performance of Private Banks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The wide nature of corporate social responsibility (CSR) management affects all firms, particularly financial and non-financial ones, when it comes to meeting consumer expectations with goods and services. Despite previous research on corporate social responsibility and financial success, there is little written literature on the topic. Few research have been published despite their existence. This essay examines how corporate social responsibility affects company success. A few Indian private sector banks are the focus of the investigation. First, the research will provide the groundwork for corporate social responsibility. This will be done by using public CSR spending from chosen organizations. Despite its modest sample size of private sector banks, this study is relevant to existing knowledge. This does not diminish its importance. This research shows that corporate economic success and social responsibility are inextricably linked. Due to the studies' conclusion. Its a significant contribution to study on corporate social responsibility and financial performance in India after the epidemic! This research links corporate social responsibility spending to transparency and gives market value, profitability, and risk ratio metrics. It replaces the chosen private banks' operational and financial performance.

articleTitle: Sustainability of Manging Complex Psychology in AI & Legal Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in legal decision-making promises enhanced efficiency, accuracy, and consistency. However, the inherent complexity of legal reasoning, coupled with the need for fairness and ethical considerations, poses significant challenges. This study examines the role of psychology in managing these complexities, focusing on cognitive biases and human-AI interactions. We develop a Cognitive Bias Analysis Framework (CBAF) to identify and mitigate biases in AI systems and conduct Human-AI Interaction Studies (HAIS) to understand the perceptions and trust of legal professionals towards AI. Our findings highlight the importance of psychological insights in designing AI systems that are transparent, fair, and aligned with human ethical values, ultimately contributing to a more equitable legal system.

articleTitle: Secure Cloud based Process-Oriented Teaching-Quality Approach in Higher Education with General AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The integration of General AI with secure cloud-based technologies offers transformative potential for enhancing teaching quality in higher education. This paper explores a process-oriented approach that combines advanced AI capabilities with robust cloud infrastructure to address contemporary challenges in educational institutions. By focusing on systematic instructional design, data-driven decision-making, and stringent security measures, this framework aims to improve pedagogical practices, streamline administrative processes, and safeguard sensitive information. The study evaluates the impact of various AI technologies on teaching quality and student satisfaction, highlighting significant improvements in personalized learning, automated grading, and predictive analytics. The findings suggest that AI-driven solutions not only enhance educational outcomes but also contribute to greater operational efficiency and data security. This innovative paradigm provides a comprehensive model for modernizing higher education through secure, scalable, and process-oriented approaches.

articleTitle: Engineering Approach for Corporate Social Responsibility on Brand Reputation and Consumer Behavior
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Corporate social responsibility (CSR) is a factor in customer behavior and brand reputation. Brand reputation, customer behavior, and corporate social responsibility are complexly linked in this research. This research reveals that a company's social and environmental obligations influence stakeholders' decisions. Research shows this influence is significant. This study believed CSR influences customer behavior and brand reputation. Brand equity and consumer decisions are affected by CSR. Research on psychology, international business ethics, and marketing has exploited this theory. Data from different sectors is used to evaluate how CSR influences customer behavior and business views. Case studies and quantitative data explore CSR approaches to boost brand optimism and consumer involvement. The fact that CSR boosts business reputation was shocking. Socio-environmental companies are well-regarded. When shopping, consumers appreciate ethical and social responsibilities. Ecological and social groups care most. In the research, openness and communication may improve the influence of CSR on consumer behavior and business perceptions. The study investigates how these two factors impact their relationship. Customers and CSR may benefit from stakeholder engagement and compelling tales. The investigation revealed CSR issues. This involves stakeholder mistrust and greenwashing. Social responsibility reduces risks and maintains customer trust. The link between corporate social responsibility (CSR) and customer behavior and industry brand reputation is examined in this research. In socially conscious consumer markets, CSR may boost brand awareness, customer loyalty, and economic growth. Since the instances are related, it may be beneficial.

articleTitle: Bayesian and Genetic Optimization for Human Activity Recognition with CNN and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Recent advancement of wearable sensor technology causes an increase use on human activity recognition (HAR) due to its superior performance and portability. HAR is applied on potential applications such as ambient assisted living, home automation, healthcare, games, monitoring, and inquiring activities. This study focuses on predicting human activities from the PAMAP2 dataset utilizing Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models. Both models are optimized using Bayesian Optimization (BO) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) techniques precise classification. The research started with a comprehensive Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to discover the fundamental construction of activity data. CNN and LSTM models are then implemented and optimized for hyperparameter tuning, enhancing predictive performance. The proposed study is assessed on various metrics, with accuracy, which ranged from 93.8% to 95.35%. Furthermore, a comparative analysis is conducted to identify the most effective model for human activity prediction, highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of each approach.

articleTitle: Cyber Security and Marketing Strategies: Protecting Customer Data Maximizing Social Media Engagement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to investigate the ways in which companies use customer Information to engage in social media while simultaneously maintaining the customers' privacy and security while doing extremely. in addition the facility of targeted selling has seen associate in nursing gain inch the list of instances of individuality larceny information breaches and cyberattacks Because the coming of the digital mature. articleTitle: Advancements in User Interfaces and Immersive Technologies in Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Virtual reality and immersive environments are key research areas with wide applications in scientific and educational fields. These technologies require new approaches for interactive features, demanding innovative narratives and user relationships. As ICT advances, it is crucial to develop new methods for information representation and user interaction within immersive environments. Virtual reality and related technologies on the virtuality continuum are emerging as powerful media for constructing and representing ideas. This review examines the latest capabilities of immersive digital technologies and their future potential. We discuss the evolution of these technologies, including virtual reality, and their applications in various scientific, artistic, informational, and educational contexts. We conclude that virtual reality is both a technological innovation and a concept that can integrate with user experience (UX) and interaction design, aiding in the creation of new experiences and expressive models for diverse research and educational domains.

articleTitle: Technological Mitigation of the Impact of Behavioral Biases on Financial Investment Decision: Evidence from India using A PLS-SEM Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: In current times, investing skills have become highly essential for a safe and financially secure life of an individual. The investor is mostly assumed to be a rational person; however, the rise of behavioural finance and economics has shown that investors are not always rational. Instead, they are 'normal', meaning their investment decisions get influenced by various behavioural biases. Individuals' investment decisions are influenced by behavioural biases. The tendency for decision-making to result in irrational financial decisions due to flawed cognitive reasoning or reasoning impacted by emotions is referred to as behavioural biases in finance. The study analyzed the impact of behavioural biases, such as overconfidence and herd mentality, on the financial investment decision of retail investors in India. For conducting a preliminary statistical analysis, the study used SPSS 23.0. In order to test the theoretical model, the study employed partial least square regression-based structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM). The impact of Herd Behaviour and Overconfidence Bias on Financial Investment Decision was positive and significant (β= 0.292; β= 0.088 respectively). The statistical tests for PLS-SEM were conducted using Smart PLS 4.0. The results of hypothesis testing using PLS-SEM, along with the values of path coefficients, T-statistics, and p-values, determined the impact of behavioural aspects on investment decision. The study highlighted that behavioural aspects of an individual are very important in influencing Financial Investment Decision.

articleTitle: Intelligent Engineering on Forensic Science Experts for Sustainable Practices in Justice System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This research paper explores the significant impact of advanced scientific investigation on the criminal justice system. With the advent of cutting-edge technology and continuous scientific advancements, the integration of these tools and techniques has brought about substantial changes in the way crime scenes are investigated, evidence is collected, preserved, and analyzed, and subsequently used in legal proceedings. This review highlights some of the major branches of forensic science, followed by a discussion of the latest developments and advances made in each area. Further, the article sheds light on the positive consequences of implementing such progressive methodologies on the overall functioning of the criminal justice system, drawing attention to certain challenges and ethical considerations that come with it

articleTitle: Responsible AI on National Cybersecurity Strategy with Enhancement of Cybersecurity in Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: For national cybersecurity to keep up with the digital transition, AI is more important than ever. Responsible AI improves cybersecurity and education by emphasizing openness and ethics. Ethical design is stressed from the outset in responsible AI. This article analyzes how artificial intelligence (AI) influences the national cybersecurity strategy, focusing on cybersecurity education development and effectiveness. The National Cybersecurity Strategy will frame this article. The major results show that responsible AI improves threat detection and response, cybersecurity infrastructure, talent shortage filling, collaborative research, and public trust. Educational institutions may now offer innovative training programs thanks to artificial intelligence. Completing this aim requires closing the gap between conventional methodologies and modern challenges. Closing gaps is vital. Functional artificial intelligence improves national cybersecurity and educational quality. This analysis shows that this conclusion is possible. This allows experts to properly react to shifting dangers. This is why it matters.

articleTitle: Innovative Practice on Tuberculosis Detection for Pneumonia Diagnosis using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: One of the top 10 major causes of death is the bacterial disease tuberculosis (TB), which is brought on by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Acute pulmonary TB manifests as acute tuberculosis pneumonia (TP). Acute TP and non-tuberculous community-acquired pneumonia, however can be mistaken for one another, which can cause TP to worsen if treatment is put off. In order to stem the spread of TB, an early and precise diagnosis of acute TP is essential. Additionally, the development of new diagnostic tools (technology and techniques) as well as the flexible implementation of various therapy plans will aid in lowering the prevalence of TP and advancing the objective of putting an end to the TB epidemic.

articleTitle: Innovation Champions in Agile Sprints: A Framework for Identification and Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Agile sprint processes are increasingly utilized within organizations due to a more dynamic environment and pressure for innovation. Innovation champions, as driving individuals of innovation, are being recognized as critical factors for the success of innovation projects. Previous studies have mainly analyzed the role of innovation champions and team composition in agile sprints separately. This research aims to develop a framework for identifying innovation champions and integrating them into sprints. The research question is: "How can innovation champions be identified within organizations and integrated into agile sprints?" To answer this research question, a three-step methodology is chosen: Firstly, the state of the art is reviewed in the literature. Secondly, qualitative interviews with eleven experts, using a semi-structured guide, are conducted for empirical research. The aim of the interviews is to analyze the sprint methodology used in the organizations and the environment provided for the sprints. This provides data on the extent to which innovation champions are integrated into sprint teams and what role and influence they assume. Thirdly, a category system for possible fields of action is derived and a set of recommendations for organizations is developed. The results show that innovation champions are often an essential element in sprints. The role and influence of innovation champions in sprints depend on different internal factors and it is revealed that due to everyday business constraints, the focus is often too much on availability and organizational structures rather than individual talents. The resulting framework from this research can support organizations by providing criteria and processes to ensure the identification of innovation champions in organizations and their integration into sprints. It shows to be crucial to give innovation champions the freedom to leverage their strengths and fully benefit from the agility of sprints.

articleTitle: Design of an Efficient Diffuser for Horizontal Axis Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Horizontal axis wind turbines, often known as HAWTs for short, are the kind of technology that is most frequently used in large-scale wind farms. Wind power is now one of the renewable energy sources that is expanding at the fastest rate right now. Despite the many advantages that HAWT energy harvesting provides, it is still a challenging endeavor to work toward achieving the highest possible level of efficiency. In situations when the wind speed varies between very high and moderate levels, this last claim is particularly relevant and applicable. Through the use of diffuser-augmented designs, the objective of the research, which is to enhance the performance of HAWT vehicles, will be attained. Through the use of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) models and testing in the actual world, the purpose of this investigation is to investigate the manner in which various diffuser shapes influence the effectiveness of turbine design. The findings make it abundantly evident that the use of certain diffuser designs has the potential to significantly boost the power coefficient. The reduction of pressure drops, the enhancement of overall performance, and the exertion of all possible effort to enhance airflow around the rotor are all possibilities for achieving this objective. Our efforts, therefore, contribute to the fulfillment of the worldwide need for renewable energy sources by making it possible to create hybrid air water turbines (HAWTs) that are both more cost-effective and more efficient.

articleTitle: Analyzing Trends, Skills Demand, and Salary Prediction in the AI and ML Job Market
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This paper includes a detailed analysis on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) job market in the United States from the year 2022 to 2024. To understand changes and new emerging sectors, the study analyzes characteristics of job offerings in terms of titles, geography, required skills, and salary within a high volume job posting data. This evaluation identifies the skills, including Python programming and ML which are most in demand and remarkable disparity across regions within the United States. Moreover, the salary prediction achieved high accuracy using these attributes based on machine learning algorithms such as the Logistic Regression Model to estimate salary ranges according to job descriptions and experience and the Geographical Coordinates Model to estimate salary according to location. The paper also offers a geographical distribution of AI/ML jobs to show where these occupations are most prevalent, including major metro areas. The paper’s contribution for job seekers, employers, and policymakers is that the results can guide them toward better understanding the current requirements of the economic sector and towards closing the AI/ML skills gaps. Therefore, the study provides a snapshot of the current market and a forecast of the future demand for such skills as a foundation for any career and business development planning.

articleTitle: A Critical Study on Effectively Managing and Addressing the Diverse Needs and Complexities Encountered by Foreign Workers in the Republic of Singapore
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Foreign workers make up over 33% of Singapore's workforce, playing an essential role in key sectors such as construction, healthcare, and domestic services. Despite their significant contributions, they face numerous challenges, including inadequate legal protection, exploitative working conditions, low wages, long hours, and substandard accommodations. These issues are often exacerbated by abuse, discrimination, social isolation, and cultural barriers, with the COVID-19 pandemic further heightening their vulnerability through increased health risks, mental well-being concerns, and xenophobic attacks. This study examines the impact of societal attitudes, government policies, and employer practices on migrant workers' experiences in Singapore. Data collected from 294 migrant workers through questionnaires, semi-structured interviews, and testimonies reveal persistent challenges, including dissatisfaction with salaries (41%), accommodation (62%), and over 20% reporting abuse and discrimination. Migrant domestic workers (MDWs) particularly feel overworked (30%), undervalued (38%), and dissatisfied with their living conditions. They call for regulated work hours, salary premiums due to health risks from extreme environmental conditions, and greater respect and recognition for their contributions. The research highlights the need for stronger legal protections, enhanced enforcement of labour rights, and greater accountability from employers to ensure fair wages and decent working conditions. It also emphasizes the importance of promoting social integration, equality, and anti-discrimination initiatives to reduce isolation and improve the quality of life for migrant workers. A comprehensive approach, involving collaboration between government policies, employer practices, societal initiatives, and community engagement, is crucial in empowering foreign workers, improving their well-being, and fostering a more inclusive and equitable society in Singapore.

articleTitle: Unique Approach to Machine Learning-based Fault Detection in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Transmission lines are essential for electricity networks. Transmission lines distribute electricity throughout its grid. However, faults along these lines are abnormal occurrences that might destroy the transmission system if they persist. IEC61850-based digital substations may provide sampled value measurements for issue investigations. In addition to model-based defect detection, machine learning techniques are being studied in the literature. This study examines a machine learning (ML) fault classifier that uses voltage and current data. A machine learning-based fault classifier improves fault classification performance, unlike the support vector machine (SVM) and recurrent neural network (RNN). This strategy differs from others. Statistics from a PSRC D6 benchmark dataset will be utilized to build the model. Classification performance will be shown using classifier assessment measures including accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and confusion matrix.

articleTitle: Female Entrepreneurs:Breaking Boundaries of Gender Preconceptions and Pioneering Startup Innovations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Background- This study looks at how women business owners have dealt with discrimination in the workplace and what they've done to help startups thrive. Female entrepreneurs are flourishing despite structural obstacles because they bring new ideas and a wider range of expertise to the table. The purpose of this study is to highlight the successes of female business owners who are breaking down gender preconceptions in the workplace, and to investigate the driving forces behind their success, the obstacles they've had to overcome, and the methods they've used to launch successful new ventures. Paper is purely based on qualitative analysis of secondary data available on social media platforms and work published in journals, magazines, newspapers about female entrepreneurs and also based on papers reviewed by authors. Findings suggest that female entrepreneurs face unique obstacles, including limited access to funding, lack of role models and support networks, and biased societal expectations. However, they also demonstrate resilience and resourcefulness in overcoming these barriers, leveraging their strengths in communication, collaboration, and empathy to build successful businesses.Implications of the study-The study will remain fruitful for those females who are still dreaming off to enter in this entrepreneurial world. The study highlighted the need for increased support and visibility for female entrepreneurs to promote gender equality in entrepreneurship and enhance innovation and economic growth.

articleTitle: AI based Analysis of Hyperspectral Images with Spectacular Efficacy in Video Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Hyperspectral imaging and artificial intelligence (AI) have transformed imaging and data processing through their ability to capture and analyze detailed spectral information. This paper explores the integration of hyperspectral imaging with AI, focusing on its impact on video analytics. Hyperspectral imaging provides comprehensive, multi-dimensional data by capturing a wide range of spectral wavelengths, enabling precise material identification and environmental monitoring beyond traditional RGB imaging. The synergy between hyperspectral imaging and AI enhances real-time analysis and decision-making by leveraging deep learning algorithms for pattern recognition and anomaly detection. This study introduces a novel AI-based hyperspectral image analysis approach for video analytics, utilizing convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and hybrid CNN-attention models to improve object recognition and classification. The methodology is validated through experiments that measure classification accuracy, processing speed, and resilience to varying conditions. Results demonstrate significant improvements in accuracy and efficiency over traditional methods, highlighting the potential for advanced applications in surveillance, environmental monitoring, and industrial quality control.

articleTitle: Predictive Energy Analytics for Intelligent Energy Management in Green Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The motive of the research is to investigate the significance of predictive energy analysis in intelligent energy management systems that are environmentally friendly integrated to buildings. This innovative framework integrates advanced machine learning algorithms with IoT sensor networks to optimize energy consumption in green buildings. The system employs ensemble methods, combining time series forecasting models (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet) with deep learning architectures (LSTM, GRU) to predict energy demand patterns. Real-time data from smart meters, occupancy sensors, and weather APIs feed into a feature engineering pipeline, extracting relevant temporal and contextual information. The predictive models inform a reinforcement learning-based control system, which dynamically adjusts HVAC, lighting, and power distribution systems. This approach achieves significant energy savings while maintaining occupant comfort through adaptive setpoint optimization. The system's modular architecture facilitates seamless integration with existing building management systems, ensuring scalability and interoperability across diverse green building environments. This paper illustrates short-term energy predictive analysis techniques and tools as well as the ones for intelligent management of energy systems simultaneously with exploring links between this technology and the green construction. Such descriptions and real-life examples also greatly highlight how predictive energy analytics can efficiently help in energy conservation in various green building applications.

articleTitle: Metaverse Adoption Intention of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs): Unclogging Communication with the Authorities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Metaverse which is an amalgam of some of the recent technologies such as artificial intelligence, 5G, and extended reality is destined to bring about a significant digital transformation of our physical lives. This study investigates the factors influencing the adoption intention of the metaverse by micro, small, and medium enterprises to facilitate interaction with Government authorities The data is used to analyze data collected from 148 owners of MSMEs. The analysis of the results indicates that performance expectancy, effort expectancy, support from metaverse vendors, and collective capability, all have significant positive relationship, while anxiety, and price have no impact on intention to adopt metaverse.

articleTitle: From Connection to Growth: An Assessment of the Potential of FTTX in India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The Indian telecommunications industry is growing rapidly, but its digital infrastructure is yet to reach full potential. Fiber-to-the-x (FTTx) is a high-speed broadband network that delivers fiber optic cables directly to the user’s premises, enabling faster internet speeds and improved connectivity. This research paper assesses the potential impact of FTTx technology on India’s economic growth. The paper examines the current state of the telecommunications industry in India and analyzes the factors that are hindering the growth of FTTx technology in the country. The potential benefits of FTTx, including increased broadband penetration, enhanced e-commerce, and improved access to e-learning and telemedicine services, are highlighted. The authors also discuss the challenges faced by FTTx technology in India, such as high installation costs and insufficient regulatory support. It reviews the existing literature on the impact of FTTx on economic growth and development in other countries. A theoretical framework is developed to evaluate the potential impact of FTTx on India’s economic growth based on this evidence. The paper suggests that FTTx can promote economic growth by improving productivity, enabling digital transformation, and supporting entrepreneurship. The paper concludes that FTTx has substantial potential to promote economic growth in India. To facilitate the expansion of FTTx technology, targeted policy interventions such as tax incentives, regulatory reforms, and public-private partnerships are recommended. The adoption of FTTx technology could lead to a substantial increase in GDP, as evidenced by the experience of other countries. Therefore, the Indian government should prioritize the development of FTTx infrastructure to realize its full potential as a catalyst for economic growth.

articleTitle: A Contemporary Updated Review of Trending Domains in Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)

articleTitle: Factors Influencing the Intention to Use Financial Technology through Central Bank Digital Currency in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This research direct to find out the influence that support the point to use CBDC in Indonesia by focusing on the Perceived Trust, Perceived Risk, Perceived Effectiveness, Perceived Ease of Use, and Attitude towards factors. CBDC is quite difficult to implement remembering it use blockchain technology and cryptography which is still new and not yet widely used and it offers easier cross border transaction and a high level of security, but if users cannot maintain the privacy of their data, of course it remains open opportunities and are vulnerable to detrimental cyber-attacks. By looking at the advantages and disadvantages of CBDC, researchers see that CBDC is a technology that is like a double-edged sword that is interesting to research its acceptance of use. In this study, researchers used 463 respondents who live in Indonesia which mostly from Tangerang, Depok, Bekasi, Jakarta, and Bogor that know about CBDC as samples. The research model used is modified TAM or Technology Acceptance Model with main affect consisting of Perceived Effectiveness, Perceived Trust, Perceived Ease of Use, Intention to Use, Attitude way, and Perceived Risk. The research results from using SmartPLS 4 show that Perceived Effectiveness, Perceived Trust, Perceived Risk, and Perceived Ease of Use are significant towards Attitudes towards. Then Perceived Effectiveness and Attitude were significant on Intention to Use, but Perceived Ease of Use was not significant and had a negative effect on Intention to Use. This study could provide a precious reference for identifying key factors to focus on in developing the intention to use CBDC in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing the Intention to Use Digital Banking in the Greater Jakarta
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The transition to digital banking (digibnak) is influenced by several factors, including Ease of Use Perception, Usefulness Perception, Risk Perception, Attitude, Self-Efficacy, and Trust. This research examines the determinants that shape individuals' intend to utilize digibank services, offering valuable insights into the drivers of usage intention. It also highlights the broader implications of the digital age on the banking sector, emphasizing the widespread adoption of digibank and the challenges encountered during this transition. Key factors such as User Experience, Service Quality, and Security Measures are identified as crucial in fostering trust and encouraging the use of digibank services. The research methodology employed SmartPLS for data analysis and utilized Google Forms to collect data from 454 respondents in the Jabodetabek region, all of whom met the eligibility criteria for further processing. The study focused on developing hypotheses to explore the relationships between critical variables, such as Ease of Use Perception, Usefulness Perception, Risk Perception, Attitude, Self-Efficacy, and Trust, and their impact on individuals’ willingness to adopt digibank services. The findings demonstrated strong convergent and discriminant validity, as well as robust path coefficients, indicating significant relationships between several variables and the intend to utilize digibank. The results provide a comprehensive understanding of the factors influencing digibank adoption, offering both theoretical and practical implications for the industry. Ultimately, this research aims to advance knowledge of the determinants driving digibank usage intention and contribute to hypothesis testing regarding the potential effects of these factors on adoption behavior.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of various machine learning models that aim at analyzing Climate Change and Extreme weather patterns
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Extreme weather events like floods, heavy rains, and droughts have become more constant and intensive as a result of climatic change. There are three machine learning (ML) models correlated in this study: Random Forest (RF), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and regression methods (such as Support Vector Regression and Decision Trees). The ability of these models to predict extreme weather occurrences, simulate climate conditions, and analyze air quality in urban environments is assessed. Although all the models described in this paper performed well, their strengths, weaknesses, and applicability to climatology and other types of simulations are also analyzed in addition to the exceptional gaps that need further research to decide which model is more suitable for predicting extreme meteorological phenomena. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Determining Intention of Adopting Artificial Intelligence Based Supply Chain Finance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The aim of this study is to examine the factors that affect Omani SMEs' propensity to employ artificial intelligence-based supply chain finance (SCF). Artificial intelligence-powered supply chain finance (SCF) has the potential to greatly improve financial performance, increase liquidity, and lower supply chain risks. For small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs) with little funding, this is particularly true. To examine a number of traits, including awareness, cost-benefit analysis, business support, perceived usefulness, and simplicity of use, the research used a conceptual model based on the theory of planned behavior and the technology acceptance model. Small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs) participated in an online survey; however, only 36 of the responses were bootstrapped to 100 for analysis. The results show that attitude, expected benefit, and perceived ease of use are among the characteristics that substantially impact the intention to use SCF. However, there is no obvious correlation between corporate support, cost-benefit analysis, and awareness. The results of this study demonstrate the need of increasing knowledge and comprehension of SCF, particularly in developing nations, in order to boost the number of small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs) that use the technology and enhance their financial sustainability.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis Through Machine Learning: Fatal Road Crashes in Delhi, India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Road crashes are the sixth leading cause of death in India. At present, most of the metropolitan cities of India are going through the burden of rising road accidents and an associated increase in fatalities. Among them, Delhi accounts for one of the highest number of road accidents in India. The study has explored the ongoing trend of fatal road crashes in Delhi from 2004 to 2022 using the data concerned. Least square Method is the most efficient way for prediction of future to forecast data using Time Series Analysis. The results of this study show that the number of fatal crashes will decrease until the year 2027 provided the strict control measures continued to be followed.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Impact of Psychological Factors on Legal Decision-Making Process
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into the legal domain promises to revolutionize decision-making by enhancing efficiency, accuracy, and fairness. However, the intersection of AI and legal decision-making is complex, influenced by both technological capabilities and psychological factors. This study explores the psychological dimensions affecting AI's role in legal processes, examining cognitive biases, trust, emotional impacts, and ethical considerations. By understanding these factors, we can develop AI systems that not only streamline legal operations but also ensure equitable and transparent outcomes. Through a multidisciplinary approach combining insights from psychology, law, and computer science, this research highlights the importance of addressing psychological influences to harness AI's full potential in the legal field.

articleTitle: Intelligent Healthcare Industry: Cyber Safety and Security in Chennai
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The Indian industry has several obstacles and some of the most pressing concerns that firms encounter due to the quickly changing economic environment. AI is changing healthcare and promises better patient outcomes, cost savings, and operational efficiency. Organizations are adapting to a rapidly changing technology environment. However, Al in healthcare systems raises cyber security risks. This study examines how artificial intelligence and healthcare affect cyberspace safety and security. This paper will examine current trends, challenges, and best practices for protecting sensitive healthcare data from cyberattacks while boosting AI efficiency. Descriptive research uses standardized questionnaires to gather data. To guarantee data validity and dependability, the questionnaire study design was carefully created. Chennai health care workers provide the questionnaire. Simple random selection selects study respondents. Correlation, linear regression, and percentage analysis were utilized to analyze the data and learn how artificial intelligence (AI) improves Chennai's healthcare industry.

articleTitle: Enhancing Student Outcomes with LSTM-CNN and Data Analytics in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: With a focus on the use of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) approaches to predict students' academic performance, the study provides an extensive review of the literature on the application of artificial neural networks (ANNs) and machine learning (ML) techniques. The study highlights the possible advantages of implementing cutting-edge technology innovations like analytics and data mining in learning environments. The analysis reveals that the reviewed literature primarily focuses on higher education. The results show that LSTM-CNN and data mining methodologies are consistently integrated, suggesting a trend in using these combined approaches to evaluate academic progress. No observable patterns were found in spite of the variability in the input variables, which was dictated by the study's context and the availability of data. It is acknowledged, nevertheless, that there is a dearth of hard data regarding the effective application of these strategies for raising student achievement and outcomes. The study emphasizes how critical it is to close the theoretical and practical divides regarding the limited applicability of LSTM-only CNN models in practical educational contexts. It highlights the need for more research to address this discrepancy and suggests putting more effort into creating and putting into practice strategies that directly improve student performance and help schools achieve their goals.

articleTitle: AI in Bioinformatics and Genomics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has revolutionized various fields, including bioinformatics and genomics, by offering powerful tools and techniques to analyse and interpret complex biological data. This research paper explores the significant role of AI in bioinformatics and genomics, highlighting its applications, advancements, challenges, and future directions. Through a comprehensive review of relevant literature, case studies, and examples, and aims the power of AI transformation to provide insights on the study of biological systems, accelerating advancements in personalized medicine and biotechnology and enhancing our understanding of genomics. These areas have risen from the needs of biologists to utilize and help interpret the vast amounts of data that are constantly being gathered in genomic research. Artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly gained attention in bioinformatics research and computational molecular biology has become common for the researchers to apply the off-shelf systems with the availability of different types of AI algorithms. At present researchers are facing difficulties in choosing the best method that could be applied to a specific data set, with various intelligent methods available in the literature. The researchers need to apply machine learning and AI with different tools and techniques which present the data in an annotated with context, estimates of accuracy, proper predictions and explanation. comprehensible fashion. This article aims to review the use of AI in the areas of bioinformatics and computational molecular biology (DNA sequencing). The AI in functional genomics, and its application in this paper defines the importance of applicability and interpretability including ethical, legal and economic issues.

articleTitle: Bone Fracture Detection Using YoloV9
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a Bone Fracture Detection System at the forefront of YOLOv9-T concerning the detection and localization of the actual site of bone fracture in X-ray images. The system would help quickly and reliably in giving a fracture diagnosis, and that is a critical side of health care sometimes it has the power to actually determine the result of some treatment. This included elbow, finger, forearm, humerus, shoulder, and wrist fractures. Efficiency and accuracy of object detection by the model were improved with the use of the YOLOv9-T on object detection tasks. With system bounding box annotation, the testing accuracy reached up to 96.50%. This study, therefore, highlights the needs for developing more advanced models of machine learning into the workflow of medical imaging probably that could be leading to lesser numbers of diagnostic errors and faster time lines in treatments in the clinic. Results The system proposed by this study is likely to be helpful in a medical practice where the efficiency as well as the accuracy about the diagnosis may be augmented.

articleTitle: Role of AI and Machine Learning in Creating Personalized Marketing Experiences
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: In the framework of the digital economy, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are having an effect on the manner in which businesses promote their goods. It is possible for companies to make the most of their marketing expenditures, predict the behavior of their customers, and personalize their content experiences with the assistance of these technologies. The analysis of enormous amounts of data enables artificial intelligence and machine learning to give personalized product ideas, improved customer experiences, and dynamic pricing. These capabilities are made possible by the combination of this technology. Using a variety of methodologies, the objective of this study is to assess the efficiency of marketing campaigns that are driven by artificial intelligence. The creation of this advertising campaign is accomplished by the collection of information through the use of case studies, interviews with industry experts, and surveys. The use of tailored marketing that is driven by artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to increase conversion rates and boost return on investment. In spite of this, the research highlights concerns over the privacy of data, the unfairness of algorithms, and the appropriate uses of artificial intelligence. In the event that artificial intelligence and machine learning are used in an acceptable manner, it is anticipated that the marketing industry would see significant transformations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Efficiency of Declarative Aggregation for Video Analytics Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The rapid expansion of video data necessitates advanced techniques for efficient processing and analysis. This paper addresses the challenges associated with declarative aggregation and limit queries in video analytics by leveraging neural networks to optimize query execution. Traditional methods often struggle with the volume and complexity of video data, leading to performance bottlenecks. Our research introduces novel algorithms that exploit neural network parallelism to enhance the efficiency of these queries. We propose a framework that integrates neural networks with custom query processing engines, focusing on spatial and temporal aggregation, as well as limit queries. Through extensive experimental studies, including real-world scenarios, we demonstrate significant improvements in query performance. Our results highlight the effectiveness of our approach in reducing processing times and increasing throughput, paving the way for more responsive and scalable video analytics systems.

articleTitle: AI Chatbots in Banking: Exploring Key Factors Influencing Customer Satisfaction through the extended E-SQUAL Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Chatbots, an Artificial Intelligence conversational agent that interacts with human users, have become integral to modern banking, offering real-time customer support and automating routine inquiries. This study seeks to identify the primary factors affecting customer satisfaction with chatbots through the use of an online survey. A structured questionnaire with variables from the extended E-SQUAL model was employed in the study to assess customer satisfaction with chatbot services. The findings indicate that key elements influencing customer satisfaction with banking-sector chatbots are performance expectancy, responsiveness, and reliability. The research offers valuable insights for technology providers and banking institutions to refine chatbot interactions, ultimately enhancing customer satisfaction. Future work can explore the integration of advanced technologies like AI and natural language processing, and personalization of chatbot interactions to cater to diverse customer needs.

articleTitle: Intelligent Techniques for Managing Employee Performance: Addressing Psychosocial Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This study examines the pros and cons of AI on worker performance. For instance, AI-related psychological issues are being studied. Studies show that AI may improve workplace decision-making and efficiency. Psychological constraints include job insecurity, solitude, and the drive to improve. It has these traits. The following are some probable outcomes. Research includes qualitative and quantitative employee performance and psychological well-being assessments. HR professionals and employees are interviewed qualitatively. Additionally, quantitative evaluations are given. Qualitative interviews enhance the investigation. Employee engagement is assessed by this research. This study also includes measurements. Various strategies were used to collect and analyse data for the inquiry. AI enhanced productivity by 16.7%, according to studies. This happened after AI was deployed. However, psychological issues persist and need considerable therapy to reduce their impact. This research found that a flexible, AI-powered workplace that prioritises employee mental health and engagement is urgently needed. "Artificial intelligence" is shortened "AI."

articleTitle: Cybercrimes in Society 5.0: Trust of Generation-Z
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: In Society 5.0, cybercrime is always growing. By identifying this and adopting proactive measures, we may move toward a time when technology empowers us without compromising our security and safety. A hyperconnected society with advanced technological integration is known as Society 5.0. The first generation to have lived exclusively in the digital era is Generation Z. With the rise of Society 5.0, it has become essential to understand how knowledgeable Generation Z (Gen-Z) is about cybercrimes. This study examines the factors affecting trust of Gen Z’s, within the context of Society 5.0, considering increase of cybercrimes. To determine these factors, a survey was conducted through a questionnaire. Regression analysis was done on the collected data, to know about the important variables affecting awareness of Gen-Zs in context of cybercrimes. The analysis found four such factors which are important to enhance trust of this generation for cyber activities.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Suicidal Ideation Model: Increasing Scale rate Among Students
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: Going through a recent survey the suicidal tendency mainly noticed among the university/ college students students between the age group of 18-25 years, considering the circumstances such as family Pressure, failure in exam, economic condition, gender issue, bullying etc. As college students are more affected in such a scenario. So, steps are taken for University/College students to fill-out a form which contain questionnaires considering the above factors. Anxiety, depression, frustration, stress lead to the misstep taken by teenagers which is Suicide. In their academic year, 94.8% of university students who had suicidal thoughts had been so miserable that they lacked motivation and function low selfesteem, outside control, helplessness, impulsion, aggression. More than 90% of those who successfully committed suicide had at least one psychological disorder at the time of their deaths, such as rage disorder, anxiety disorder, and antisocial behavior, are personality traits that are connected in some way to suicidal thoughts. The research is all about finding or the factors which effect the students life more due to which they take such aggressive steps. By controlling the factor can lead to safeguard of that one life and also making students free of such such ill mental health which affect their lifestyle university students present significant risk factors for depression, since they need to deal with academic stress on a daily basis.

articleTitle: AI based Innovation and Competition: Crucial Role of IPRS in Antitrust Enforcement Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The interaction among innovation, competition, and IP rights is becoming prominent in dynamic markets. This paper discusses the role of IP rights in competition enforcement, showing how these rights create tension between promoting innovation and maintaining competitive markets. Patents, trademark, and copyrights—jointly referred to as IP products— are designed to achieve the objective of creating incentives for innovation through the grant of temporary exclusivity over inventions and ideas created by persons. While IP rights can be upheld, just like many other legal tools for protecting innovation and creativity, it may create hurdles in case of excessive use to existing competition. This paper will try to highlight, based on case studies and regulatory frameworks, that effective antitrust enforcement may prevent abuse of the IP rights stifling competition while encouraging innovative development in new technologies and creative works. By analyzing the dynamic interplay between IP protection and antitrust policies, it will help policymakers deal with the dual task of promoting innovation and preserving competitive market structures. The research thus hopes to be useful in recommending refinements of antitrust practices toward making sure that IP rights are supportive of both innovation and competition.

articleTitle: AI Analysis of Edge- Cloud Computing on IOT-based Large Data Storage Systems with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: This research investigates how cloud computing manages networked device data. This study examines how cloud computing manages IoT data. Data volume, kind, and velocity have increased exponentially as the Internet of Things has grown. Traditional data storage systems weren't built to handle this much data. They can't meet these standards because of this. Every user may access cloud computing, which is scalable, adaptive, and real-time. Data governance, security, and privacy challenges arise from this connection. The privacy of data is another worry. These issues resulted from integration. The purpose of this study is to understand the problems of cloud computing and IoT-based big data storage systems. To do this, we will undertake case studies, construct and test technology prototypes, and explore the literature. The challenges will be examined from several angles to achieve this goal. In order to fully enable cloud-based data storage for the Internet of Things, security, privacy, and governance must be resolved. Successfully fulfilling the promise requires overcoming these obstacles. Finding a solution to the obstacles will be impossible once these issues are resolved. Real-time processing and scalability are also emphasized as positives.

articleTitle: AI Applications and the Financial Transformation of FinTech and FinServ Sectors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into the financial technology (FinTech) and financial services (FinServ) sectors has catalyzed a profound transformation, reshaping traditional practices and driving substantial advancements in operational efficiency, customer experience, and market innovation. This paper examines the pivotal role of AI in revolutionizing these sectors through a detailed analysis of AI applications such as fraud detection, personalized banking, automated customer support, and algorithmic trading. Employing a comprehensive research methodology that includes quantitative and qualitative assessments, the study reveals how AI enhances financial performance metrics, including revenue growth, cost savings, and customer satisfaction. The findings underscore the growing significance of AI in addressing challenges and driving growth within the FinTech and FinServ industries. By examining market trends, AI integration, and regulatory dynamics, this research highlights the transformative impact of AI and its strategic importance for future development in financial services.
